verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a collection of agent skills and plugin metadata that gets installed into host agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Cursor. Acting as an MCP client is the role of those host agents, not of a skills package. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself consuming or connecting to MCP servers, so this axis is a category error here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
